title: Quality Engine Configuration
description: Project-level configuration schema for Vibe Coding OS quality engine — controls which gates run, their overrides, model profile, and task context

enabled_gates.description: Array of gate IDs to explicitly enable. If empty, defaults to all gates in the manifest

disabled_gates.description: Array of gate IDs to explicitly skip during validation runs

gate_overrides.description: Per-gate override settings keyed by gate ID

timeout.description: Override timeout in seconds for this specific gate

level.description: Override severity level for this specific gate

auto_fix.description: Override auto-fix setting for this specific gate

model_profile.description: Determines which advisory gates run based on available compute/capability. 'lean' skips heavy advisory gates, 'standard' runs typical checks, 'heavy' runs all gates including expensive analysis

task_profile.description: Describes the type of work being done, influencing which gates are most relevant. 'any' is the default that runs all appropriate gates

telemetry_enabled.description: Whether to emit telemetry events for gate execution results

output_dir.description: Directory path for storing gate execution reports and artifacts, relative to project root
